ashley-sales: FYI — Enterprise promo tied to PO 2024-456 for Acme Corp (acct_7788) was approved in the contract but customer says credits aren't showing up in their billing portal. dropping here so CS + billing can action.

luis-cs: Can you paste the PO and account ID? Customer attached screenshot of the promo/code flow failing.

ashley-sales: PO 2024-456, Account ID acct_7788, billing email billing@acme.com. Sales notes: $12,000 credit spread across first 6 months per contract. Contract e-signed + docs on the HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/deal/ACME-123 :thumbsup:

alex (Support): Checking now. I don't see any manual credits on account. Repro steps: login as acct_7788 -> Billing -> Credits shows 0. Trying to apply a promo code via UI returns "Promo code not found" — because enterprise credits are applied manually by finance, not via the promo-code UI.

alex (Support): Repro commands I ran:
```
# list credits
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" "https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acct_7788/credits"
# resp: {"credits":0}
```
Also attached customer's screenshot of the UI error and the invoice they expected to be zeroed.

jen (Billing): I'll take this. Need the signed contract and PO number (we should have both in HubSpot). I'll create a credit memo in Stripe and apply to the upcoming invoices. ETA: EOD PT today. @ashley-sales can you confirm the signed contract is on the deal?

ashley-sales: Confirmed — signed contract and PO attached to HubSpot deal. Customer also asked we add invoice note: "PO 2024-456 — credit applied per contract".

jen (Billing): Done: created credit memo CM-2024-098 for $12,000 in Stripe and applied it to acct_7788. Applied to Invoice INV-331 and left note "PO 2024-456". Created finance ticket FIN-987 for reconciliation. Billing-bot: FIN-987 created.

billing-bot: FIN-987: credit memo CM-2024-098 applied to acct_7788. Invoice INV-331 adjusted. Email notification queued to billing@acme.com.

luis-cs: I messaged the customer with the reconciliation summary and asked them to refresh the billing portal. They reported the old balance until they logged out/in — after re-login the first invoice balance is zeroed. Customer confirmed receipt and is happy. :tada:

alex (Support): Closing out here. Notes/action items: 1) Billing updated the account and left PO note. 2) Sales: please ensure PO + signed contract are attached to the HubSpot deal and include account ID next time to avoid delay. 3) Docs: updating internal playbook "enterprise credit apply checklist" with the Stripe steps and required evidence. If customer sees "Promo code not found" message, clarify enterprise credits are manual adjustments (not promo UI codes).
